standard_taps: IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() < 160 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light

IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 64 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_high_volume() X_stereo
IF generic_hood_version_1.reading() > 0.15 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN power_on() generic_hood_version_1
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
